an3.116:1.5: Rebirth depends on the interaction of multiple deeds in this life and before. The attainment of such a powerful state of meditation will normally overpower limited kamma and take the mind to rebirth in the corresponding realm ([sn42.8:12.3]()), especially when it has been well developed.
an3.116:1.6: Based on the reckoning of the aeon at [an4.123:1.6](), this would be 737.28 trillion human years.
an3.116:1.8: This discourse contradicts the oft-stated belief in modern times that the practice of absorption is dangerous because one can get stuck in a Brahmā realm and miss the chance to practice. On the contrary, a dedicated practitioner will realize awakening in that life.
an3.116:3.4: 2,211.84 trillion human years. | The lifespan of the gods of neither perception nor non-perception is not mentioned in the Suttas, but at [vb18:208.2]() it is said to be 84,000 aeons.
